neighbours.label: the second word of a fixed technical collocation in expository prose ('naturally occurring', 'self-reported', 'proposed explanation'), on the word that completes the set phrase
fire: Researchers measured a naturally occurring hormone in the saliva of the volunteers.
The survey collected self-reported sleep hours from two thousand adults.
A widely proposed explanation is that the climate became drier.
Biologists used a capture-recapture design to count the frogs in the pond.
Wages were raised in line with the cost of living to reflect inflation.
Elderly patients often under-report their symptoms to their doctors.
Many chemists prefer the internationally accepted name for the compound.
Investigators relied on self-administered questionnaires in the clinic.
quiet: Researchers measured the hormone in the saliva of the volunteers.
The survey asked two thousand adults about their sleep.
A local farmer says the climate became drier.
Biologists counted the frogs in the pond by hand.
Wages were raised last spring for all workers in the plant.
Elderly patients often visit their doctors on Monday mornings.
Many chemists keep the compound in a dark glass bottle.
Investigators handed out paper forms in the clinic.
